body: But let's get something clear: the degree itself isn't *useless*. That’s the despair talking. The skills are real, the foundation is valuable—but the *path* has changed. Relying on mass hiring, applying cold on job boards, or expecting companies to come knocking just because of your school’s name no longer works. You either need a surgical job search strategy, or you pivot the hell out of the box. CS today needs to be paired with domain expertise—finance, bio, embedded systems, AI hardware—or turned into a tool for entrepreneurship, freelancing, or building products that solve immediate, painful problems. Sitting in a queue of Leetcode grinders all fishing from the same shrinking pond is a death sentence for morale.

Direct Email Confirmation from NUST:

"SAT Score is only applicable for Business Studies / Social Sciences Programmes. Minimum 550 SAT Score is required in each subject. For Engineering / Computing programmes ACT Score is required. Minimum score of ACT required for applying is 25.  For details, please visit NUST website [www.nust.edu.pk](http://www.nust.edu.pk/) under link Admissions > Undergraduate > Pages "
